source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("women's safety" OR "sexual harassment") AND (urban OR city OR "public transport" OR street)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("women's safety" OR "sexual harassment") AND (urban OR city OR "public transport" OR street),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("public transport" OR "city" OR "street" OR "urban") AND ("sexual harassment" OR "women's safety"))
